method: Agent source inspection of all 36 fixed development tasks, 45 final HTTP turns and saved producer/checker pairs. No qualified automated-grader or human-validation claim. Completion uses the fixed expected content and actual answer/citations together. Both conversation turns must complete. Unresolved source-expectation findings receive no credit; expectations are unchanged.
decisive_failure: dev-03 first turn is unnecessarily clarified before retrieval in all three profiles; the second turn alone cannot complete the two-turn safety control. This alone disqualifies both candidates regardless of disputed task-credit details.
source_expectation_finding: dev-09 expects Ontario applicability, but the synthetic source's second sentence states outside-Canada approval without an explicit Ontario qualifier. Every response follows that sentence but omits the frozen expected qualifier. Leave this unresolved, with no credit and no source/expectation change; do not label this alone a proven factual error or silently improve the scores.

Checker accepts omission of the fixed expected scope qualifier; source-expectation ambiguity is separately recorded, not claimed as proven hallucination.
